summary.text: Single Thought Flower Blossom is one of Purple Mountain True Monarch's wisdom path killer moves. He used it among other methods to face Duke Long when he was not in peak condition.

claims.text: In Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan chooses to modify Purple Mountain True Monarch’s wisdom path killer moves because they are powerful, he has grandmaster wisdom path attainment, and he already holds a batch of wisdom path Immortal Gu left behind by Purple Mountain True Monarch. Single thought flower blossom is named in that batch with purple blood river formation, purple thought light shield, ignited thought flying rock, purple thought perception starlight, directional confusion fog, thought body defense, and single thought myriad flow elimination.

On cloud soil, after ignited thought flying rock explodes, Fang Yuan points with the index finger of his right hand. The flames go out and flowers bloom in the pits, countless flowers competing to emerge. They are vibrant and colorful, and the area becomes a field of rainbow flowers. This is a consecutive move with ignited thought flying rock. The target is cloud soil without thoughts, so the flowers are useless decorations. He wills and they vanish. The wisdom path killer moves he is using are already modified to some extent.

Against an immemorial myriad head coiling dragon in Tai Qiu, Fang Yuan shifts his thoughts and countless beautiful flowers bloom on the dragon bodies. The dragon heads feel their strength sapped and fall into weakness. The flowers are used as fuel to strengthen the flames in their mind. Together with ignited thought flying rock, these attacks quickly defeat the rank six and seven dragon heads. Fang Yuan judges this as the power of wisdom path killer moves.

Known users.text: Purple Mountain True Monarch Fang Yuan
